environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 instance in an isolated private subnet (10.0.2.0/24) within a VPC that has no internet gateway attachment and no NAT gateway. Subnet route table contains only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. VPC endpoints exist only for S3 (gateway type) and DynamoDB (gateway type) with endpoint policies restricting to the account's own resources. IMDS is configured as IMDSv2-only with hop limit of 1. Security group attached to the instance allows inbound only from the internal ALB security group on port 3000, and egress rules permit only traffic to the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) and the prefix lists for S3 and DynamoDB VPC endpoints. DNS resolution within the VPC uses Route 53 Resolver with no forwarding rules to external resolvers — all queries for non-internal zones return NXDOMAIN via a Resolver DNS Firewall rule group associated with the VPC that blocks all domains except *.amazonaws.com and the application's own internal hosted zone.

config.route53_resolver: no forwarding rules, internal resolution only
